author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In preparation for a future prop replica project, Adam gets practice with tool he's never shown before: a Holdridge Radii Cutter for making a perfect sphere. In this case, he's going to use it to attempt to make a perfect hemispheric void out of richlite on his lathe. The trick: lining up the radius cutter to be perfectly center to the material. Would you call this a hemisphere or a demisphere? 

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
